ppoi.new_repo_desc: A bare git repository is created under the data root.
ppoi.settings.title: Your settings
ppoi.settings.first_time: Register at least one data root (a shared folder on the file server) to start.
ppoi.settings.stored_in: This setting is stored in %s on this PC.
ppoi.code.clone_help: Paste into PowerShell. Includes the remote.origin.receivepack setting that works around the ownership check on push and allows long paths.
ppoi.code.empty_help: Run the following inside your existing local repository.
ppoi.pulls.revert_confirm: A commit that undoes this merge will be created on %s.
ppoi.pulls.force_pushed: Branch %s was force-pushed after this pull request was opened. Comments on earlier versions are folded under Outdated.
ppoi.pulls.approval_required: This repository requires at least one approval before merging.
ppoi.pulls.conflict_help: Merge %[2]s into %[1]s locally and push; then this pull request can be merged here.
ppoi.pulls.push_rejected: Another PC pushed first and the retries were rejected as well. Try again.
ppoi.pulls.no_open: There aren't any open pull requests.
ppoi.pulls.no_closed: There aren't any closed pull requests.
ppoi.pulls.same_branch: Base and head are the same branch.
ppoi.pulls.needs_branches: At least two branches are needed to open a pull request.
ppoi.settings.require_approval_desc: When on, a pull request cannot be merged until it has at least one approval.
ppoi.settings.deny_force_push_desc: When on, receive.denyNonFastForwards is set on the bare repository and pushes that rewrite history are rejected. This is a safeguard against mistakes: the person pushing can bypass it with -c receive.denyNonFastForwards=false. It applies to all branches.
ppoi.settings.browse_busy: The folder dialog is already open.
ppoi.settings.browse_unsupported: The folder dialog is not available on this OS. Type the path instead.
ppoi.settings.root_help: A folder that already has config.json is registered as is. A folder without it is initialized with the owner name you enter. The owner name is used in URLs, must be ASCII and cannot be changed later.
ppoi.settings.owner_format: ASCII letters, digits, . _ - only; must start with a letter or digit; must not end with .; up to 50 characters.
ppoi.settings.owner_required: A new data root needs an owner name.
ppoi.settings.duplicate_owner: A data root with owner %s is already registered (%s).
ppoi.settings.remove_confirm: Remove this data root from the list? The folder itself is not deleted.
ppoi.settings.display_name_help: If empty, your login name (%s) is shown. Written to every registered data root.
ppoi.settings.name_write_failed: The display name could not be written to some data roots: %s
ppoi.attach.hint: Paste images with Ctrl+V, or pick any file with "Attach files" (saved when you submit).
ppoi.attach.too_large: The attachment is too large (limit %d MB).
ppoi.licenses.title: Open source software and licenses
ppoi.licenses.desc: Third-party software bundled into the executable, with its license text.
ppoi.licenses.self: This tool itself is released under the MIT License.
ppoi.update.available: A newer version (Ver %s) is available. Copy the following file to this PC and restart.
ppoi.pulls.not_open: Approvals and change requests can only be added to an open pull request
ppoi.pulls.busy: Another merge or revert is in progress for this repository. Try again shortly.
ppoi.pulls.merged_but_not_recorded: The merge was pushed, but recording it failed: %s. Press merge again to record it.
ppoi.pulls.reverted_but_not_recorded: The revert was pushed, but recording it failed: %s. Press revert again to record it.
ppoi.settings.dismiss_stale_approval_des: Only matters when approval is required. When on, an approval counts only if the content of the pull request diff has not changed since it was given. Merging the base branch in keeps the approval; pushes that change the diff or force pushes invalidate it (same as Gitea).
ppoi.pulls.head_kept: Branch %s was kept because another pull request uses it as base.
ppoi.settings.maintenance_desc: Runs git gc on the bare repository. Automatic gc on push (receive.autogc) is disabled so that no client stalls on it over SMB; run it here from time to time.
ppoi.readonly.banner: Data root %s uses a data format this exe does not know (format %d; this exe supports up to %d), so it is opened read-only. Update to a newer exe.
ppoi.readonly.write: This data root is opened read-only (unknown data format). Update to a newer exe.
ppoi.dosdevice.failed: Could not define a DOS device name for data root %s, so its UNC path is used as is (%s). Git operations such as creating repositories, clone, and push may fail.
ppoi.settings.trust_note: Everyone who can write to a data root can run git commands on each other's PC (repositories on the share are opened with safe.directory=*). Use a share that only trusted members can write to. The login name (%s) comes from the USERNAME environment variable and is not verified.
ppoi.error.not_author: You can only edit or delete what you wrote.
ppoi.error.stale: Someone else changed this after you opened the page. Reload and apply again.
ppoi.cross.delay_note: Changes made on other PCs can take about 10 seconds to show up here.
ppoi.new_activity: Updated since you last opened it
ppoi.release.delete_confirm: Delete this release? The tag and the attached files will remain.
ppoi.release.assets_help: Attach files to distribute (exe, zip, ...). Multiple files allowed.
